name: Ginzburg-Landau
header:
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<VTKFile type="ImageData" version="0.1" byte_order="LittleEndian" compressor="vtkZLibDataCompressor">
  <RD format_version="3">
    <description>
                                                                                                      The complex Ginzburg-Landau equation describes a vast variety of phenomena from nonlinear 
waves to second-order phase transitions, from superconductivity, superfluidity, and 
Bose-Einstein condensation to liquid crystals and strings in field theory. 
<a href="http://hopf.chem.brandeis.edu/yanglingfa/pattern/cgle/index.html">
[link]</a>
    </description>
    <rule name="Ginzburg-Landau" type="formula" wrap="1" neighborhood_type="vertex" neighborhood_range="1" neighborhood_weight="laplacian">
      <param name="timestep">
        0.2
      </param>
      <param name="alpha">
        0.077
      </param>
      <param name="beta">
        0.93
      </param>
      <param name="delta">
        1.441
      </param>
      <param name="gamma">
        0.10099
      </param>
      <param name="D_a">
        0.23
      </param>
      <param name="D_b">
        0.151
      </param>
      <param name="D_c">
        9e-05
      </param>
      <param name="cDamp">
        0.001
      </param>
      <param name="c_power">
        2.3
      </param>
      <param name="c_mult">
        -1
      </param>
      <param name="c_sub">
        -0.001
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_Da">
        -0.2
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_Db">
        -0.1
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_a">
        0
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_b">
        -0.09
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_alpha">
        0.4
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_beta">
        -0.1
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_gamma">
        0.02
      </param>
      <param name="c_to_delta">
        0.2
      </param>
      <formula number_of_chemicals="3">
                                c = clamp( c, 0.0f, 1.0f );
delta_c = (D_c*laplacian_c) + (cDamp * -c) + clamp( pow(a*a + b*b,c_power) * c_mult - c_sub, 0.0f, 1.0f );
delta_a = (D_a + c * c_to_Da) * laplacian_a + (alpha+c*c_to_alpha)*a - (gamma+c*c_to_gamma)*b + (-(beta+c*c_to_beta)*a + (delta+c*c_to_delta)*b)*(a*a+b*b) + c * c_to_a;
delta_b = (D_b + c * c_to_Db) * laplacian_b + (alpha+c*c_to_alpha)*b + (gamma+c*c_to_gamma)*a + (-(beta+c*c_to_beta)*b - (delta+c*c_to_delta)*a)*(a*a+b*b) + c * c_to_b;
      </formula>
      
    </rule>
